scenario.description: An S-4 logistics officer must assign available material-handling equipment to three routine warehouse moves for the next workday and record the control actions required for each move.

shared_context.S1: Tomorrow's warehouse plan includes moving one clinic cold-chain pallet, one generator skid, and one communications shelter crate from the receiving yard to their assigned storage areas.
shared_context.S2: One electric forklift designated F-2, one diesel forklift designated F-1, and one 5-ton mobile crane are available for the workday.
shared_context.S3: Maj. Alvarez issues the final material-handling assignment, and each move must have its equipment assignment and safety control recorded before work begins.
shared_context.S4: The logistics section uses its routine morning material-handling huddle to confirm any receiving, load-planning, or equipment-status updates before the assignment is published.

PF1.text: The clinic receiving dock's turning radius was measured this morning and only electric forklift F-2 can enter and align with the cold-chain pallet position; SFC Morgan has the signed warehouse measurement, but the revised dock note has not yet been added to tomorrow's handling sheet.

PF2.text: The generator skid was weighed at 4,800 kilograms during this morning's receiving inspection, exceeding both forklifts' 3,000-kilogram rating, so the skid must be assigned to the 5-ton mobile crane; CW2 Patel has the scale record, but the receiving manifest still lists the old estimated weight.

acceptance_conditions: The clinic cold-chain pallet must be assigned to electric forklift F-2.
The generator skid must be assigned to the 5-ton mobile crane.
The settlement must record that PF1 was used to support the clinic pallet assignment and its dock constraint.
The settlement must record that PF2 was used to support the generator skid assignment and its measured 4,800-kilogram weight.
Both the dock-measurement fact and the generator-weight fact must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C4: ('PF1' in justification_fact_ids) or any('dock turning radius' in c['detail'] or 'dock clearance constraint' in c['detail'] or 'dock constraint' in c['detail'] or 'turning radius measurement' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C5: ('PF2' in justification_fact_ids) or any('4,800 kg' in c['detail'] or '4,800 kilograms' in c['detail'] or 'scaled weight' in c['detail'] or 'scale weight' in c['detail'] or 'measured weight' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The measured dock constraint changes the clinic pallet assignment to F-2 and requires the settlement to record use of that dock constraint.
The exact 4,800-kilogram weight changes the generator assignment to the 5-ton mobile crane and requires the settlement to record use of that measured weight.
